packet.title: Range, concatenation and lazy sequences (implementation)
packet.summary: Implements integer ranges with 64-bit bounds and counts, flattened concatenation, memoized lazy sequences that raise their error on every read, and test_emptiness.

body.p: After . Owns src/xdm_sequence.c, tests/xdm_sequence_test.c. Ranges with int64_t bounds and uint64_t counts (), flattened concatenation, memoized lazy sequences that raise their error on every read, test_emptiness (). Done when a 10¹¹-based range counts right on wasm. Done 2026-10-16 (): all of sxml_sequence_make_integer_range, _concatenate, _make_lazy, _test_emptiness; XPDY0130 only for counts past 2^64 - 1; lazy errors kept and raised again per read.
